{{Quote|Your father's ship sounds almost as deadly as the Empire's ''Death Star&mdash;!''<nowiki></nowiki>|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Mira Volz]]|<ref name="STKR" />}}
The '''''Ionic Ring''''' was a weather-control [[Starship/Legends|starship]] created by [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Renn Volz]] during his time at the [[Maw Installation]], and used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. It was named after its '''Ion Ring''' or '''Climatizer''', the weapon built into it.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|My father invented the ''Ion Ring Ship'' to turn every planet into a ''paradise!''<nowiki></nowiki>|[[Mira Volz]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="STKR" />}}
The ''Ionic Ring'' consisted of several ion units joined together in the shape of a ring. These ion units created a specific modulated ionic beam that could [[Weather control/Legends|manipulate]] a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] weather patterns.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The ''Ionic Ring'' also housed a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command bridge]] at its center and was capable of traveling through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="STKR" />

==History==
{{Quote|With this ship, I'll have the Rebellion ''begging'' for mercy!''"<br />"''My invention was meant to ''stop'' suffering, not to ''create it&mdash;!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Bzorn and Renn Volz|<ref name="STKR" />}}
[[File:Ionic_Ring_reactor.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Ionic Ring'' fires its main reactor]]
The ''Ionic Ring'' was created by [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Renn Volz]] during his tenure at the [[Maw Installation]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> Volz believed he was working for the good of the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. He envisioned the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] as a climatizer, capable of altering the destructive forces of nature to [[Terraforming/Legends|terraform]] any wasteland into a paradise of a livable world. However, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] intended to use it as a weapon against planets harboring [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cells.<ref name="STKR" />

After its first successful testing on the planet [[Zerm/Legends|Zerm]], the ''Ionic Ring'' was commandeered by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]], who had been tasked by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] to locate and punish Rebel planets. It was used to [[Devastation of Rion|devastate]] the planet [[Rion/Legends|Rion]], unleashing destructive storms. Afterward it was [[Devastation of Little Kessel|turned]] on Volz's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Little Kessel]].<ref name="STKR" />

Before the ''Ionic Ring'' could be used to fully destroy Little Kessel, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] rescued the professor who, devastated that his technology would be used for destruction by the Imperial military, took it upon himself to destroy the ship and the Ion Ring. He reversed the flow of the ship's ion units, causing a meltdown that destroyed the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. The four were barely able to escape with their lives aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="STKR" />

Even though the ''Ionic Ring'' was destroyed, other Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] at [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] utilized Volz's theories to create a new weapon, the [[orbital nightcloak]].<ref name="RES">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This ship receives multiple names throughout ''[[The Second Kessel Run]]''.<ref name="STKR" /> The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' establishes its official name as the ''Ionic Ring''.<ref name="TCSWE" />
